tower-of-hanoi.title: Output move list as final answer
tower-of-hanoi.principle: After constructing the solution, explicitly output the move list in the required [[disk, from, to], ...] format as the final part of the response; without this, the model may produce an empty move list, leading to rejection.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: Whenever you have generated a sequence of moves for a Tower of Hanoi problem.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Providing no moves or an empty list [] as the final answer.

tower-of-hanoi.why_it_happens: The model forgets to include the computed moves in the final answer, often due to truncation or placing the list before other text that the parser later ignores.
tower-of-hanoi.how_to_avoid: Ensure the move list is printed as the last parseable list in the response, after any explanatory text, and verify it is non‑empty.
